extraction.Name: Grace Burnett Giroux
extraction.Refused/Protested: Not to any outside my family, but did say to them that I wish it had not been issued as I did not want to pay taxes on the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I traded it for some other land and then lost that land by mortgage some time ago
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I had no idea of disposing of my land and would still be holding it for myself and children had the patent not been issued and taxes been assessed against it
extraction.Occupation/Income: Farming, that is my husband and I
extraction.NOTES: Signed receipt for patent; did not ask for patent; no debts settled with the man she traded with; two children depend upon her for support; is in good health; was satisfied with the trade at the time; document notarized May 14, 1929 by A. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
